north_star: Discover and validate a genuinely differentiated physiological marker that detects autonomic nervous system dysfunction or longitudinal deterioration.
primary_endpoint: Independently confirmed autonomic dysfunction or worsening of autonomic function, with domain-specific clinically appropriate reference testing.
discovery_requirement: Demonstrate a defensible difference from established measures or methods, supported by original evidence; do not claim novelty from branding or feature aggregation.
non_goals: infer broad ANS dysfunction from ECG and blood pressure alone
declare a validated biomarker without clinical reference and independent replication

decision_rules.mission_pivot_requires: Founder's explicit approval; document prior and proposed mission, rationale, tradeoffs and authorization before editing this charter.
decision_rules.agent_reports: Evidence and proposals only; agents cannot authorize a pivot, new claim, spend or change of success endpoint.
decision_rules.negative_result: Keep and report negative or null results; do not change thresholds after outcome inspection.
decision_rules.commercialization: No product claims or specialized disease pivot until founded on primary research question and expressly approved.

gates.description: Specific clinically definable impairment/progression and affected ANS domain are stated.
Original methods and direct competitors checked; precise remaining novelty is documented or declared unverified.
Independent clinical reference/ground truth and validation population are identified and accessible, or gate remains blocked.
Signal quality, repeatability, uncertainty, artifact and physiological confounder controls are verified.
Relevant existing gold-standard or state-of-art clinical comparators are measured; added clinical usefulness is tested.
Independent cohort or external validation successfully replicates the prespecified result.

current_claim: No original or clinically validated ANS deterioration biomarker has been demonstrated by Project ANS.
